author: GuruGamer46
quote:
The game has the foundations for greatness. The map is surreal and utterly beautiful. The level of detail is genuinely unparalleled and I've never seen another game even come close.

However, the physics of the game are truly horrifying. The driving is nothing at all like what rockstar have been marketing, a mix in-between gran theft auto 4 and 5.  There are elements of 5, such as the faster cars handling like they are glued to the road, and elements of 4, such as needing to press that other pedal, I think it's called 'the brake' or something along those lines. However neither of those things actually give any feeling that the driving is between 4 and 5. 

The physics are (honestly) terrible, in the way that you have no initiative connection to the cars in any sense. They handle inconsistently, one second an input barely registered, a second later that same input sends the car veering across 3 lanes of traffic. One second you hit the gas and your wheels are spinning (even this is just executed horribly), the next, same speed, same scenario, same input, no spin. 

You want to just cruise around slowly? This is where the driving is in its element, proving that you only drive in a straight line, because the second you try to take a slow corner, smoothly, the game registers that you would like to turn the steering wheel 450° and do a full U-turn.


I have seen many people being criticised as having no skill, but in my defence I have a lot of top 50 times world wide in racing Sims, and even in Forza Motorsport. I have a genuinely decent understanding of car handling and physics, and can truly say, GTA 6 is possibly the worst I've ever experienced bar the NFS games, which it is not far from.

Overall this completely ruins a game that is primarily focused on stealing cars and driving them.


It is a genuine shame, because the car models, world, roads and map are just begging to be enjoyed, however implementing such an awful driving experience is almost just cruel.

Rockstar, please fire whoever is incharge of the vehicle handling and whoever approved this god awful driving model.
